answer: Because the pulse count is verified against the signal text itself, the cedar audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 104 aliases thus means producing 104 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
